title: What Each Jurisdiction Provides
subtitle: Five jurisdictions, five features, no single regulator sees the whole

nodes.name: US Virgin Islands
nodes.role: Trust company formation with minimal reporting. VIEDC tax benefits (90% income tax reduction). Distance from mainland enforcement. Entity: STC, BBVI, all property shells.

nodes.name: New York
nodes.role: Prestige address (457 Madison Ave). Banking access (Deutsche Bank, JPMorgan). Legal infrastructure (DKIP PLLC). Entity: DKIP, Max Hotel Services, E Management.

nodes.name: Florida
nodes.role: No state income tax. Homestead exemption. Property holding. Entity: Laurel Inc property, Indyke relocation (Delray Beach).

nodes.name: New Mexico
nodes.role: Near-zero LLC filing requirements. No public disclosure of members. Entity: Cypress Inc (Zorro Ranch).

nodes.name: Delaware
nodes.role: LLC opacity — no public disclosure of members or managers. Chancery Court. Entity: Various holding LLCs.
